tagline: Blocks. Spaceships. A whole universe to explore.
gameplay_mechanics:
Mine, craft and build: every planet is fully destructible and rebuildable, block by block. Gather resources, craft tools and machines, and grow your first camp into a base with power, lights, teleporters and vehicles.

Your spaceship is the heart of the loop: take off from the surface, fly through open space in first person, go on EVA spacewalks and land on any planet you can reach. Survival systems — oxygen, energy, hunger, day/night, weather and per-planet gravity — keep exploration tense, while creatures can be fought or tamed to travel alongside you.

Built-in editors let you design your own ships, avatars, stations and towns and bring them into your worlds.
narrative_setting:
You are a lone pilot in a procedurally generated galaxy, guided by VEGA, your ship's AI. What starts as simple survival slowly becomes a mystery: who created the VEGA protocol, and why? Story fragments, settlers and hidden treasures scattered across the planets fill in the picture.

Every world type has its own character: scorching lava planets, frozen wastes, overgrown jungles, deep oceans, crystal caves, fungal forests and floating skylands.
visual_audio_style:
A colorful, readable voxel aesthetic with modern lighting: dynamic day/night cycles, weather, fog and a distinct palette for every biome, framed by a clean sci-fi holographic UI.

An original soundtrack and atmospheric sound design accompany mining, flight and exploration. The game is fully localized in English and German.
multiplayer_options: Online co-op for 2-12 players: private, password-gated worlds for friends and family (with in-game voice chat), plus shared arcade worlds here on Glitch. Singleplayer runs entirely in your browser.
dlc_expansion_info: No DLC and no in-app purchases — the game is free and open source. New content and features arrive as regular free updates.
system_requirements: Browser: any modern desktop browser with WebGL2 (Chrome, Edge, Firefox, Safari). Mouse recommended; touch controls are supported on tablets. Native builds for Windows, macOS and Linux are available on the project website; 8 GB RAM recommended.
key_features:
• Fly your own ship between procedurally generated block planets — lava, ice, ocean, jungle, desert, crystal, fungal and floating skylands
  • Fully destructible worlds: mine every block, build anywhere
  • Survival systems: oxygen, energy, hunger, day/night, weather and per-planet gravity
  • Uncover the mystery of the VEGA protocol with your ship's AI
  • Tame creatures, meet settlers, hunt hidden treasures
  • In-game editors for ships, avatars, stations and towns
  • Play solo in the browser or co-op with up to 12 players
  • Free, open source, English and German
